name: Grade 6 T2 Practice: August Week 10 - Final Challenge Plan
description: Practice words for planning and improving the final mBot challenge.

words.definition: What you are trying to do.
words.example: The goal was to follow the route.

words.definition: A simple rule that says when the task is complete.
words.example: The success rule was to stop inside the box.

words.definition: The space where a project is tried safely.
words.example: We put tape in the test area.

words.definition: A change that makes something better.
words.example: The improvement made the robot stop closer to the marker.

words.definition: A task that takes effort to complete.
words.example: The challenge was to reach the finish marker.

words.definition: Pieces that make up a device.
words.example: The robot parts include wheels and sensors.
